# Tapir commands: Element grouping Commands

The 15 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Element grouping Commands

### CreateGroups

Creates groups of the passed elements

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.4.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateGroups

Parameters:

- `elementGroups` (array of ElementGroupParameters, required): A list of element groups to create.

Returns:

- `groupGuids` (array of GroupIdOrError, required): The results of the group creation operations.

Grasshopper: `CreateGroupsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/CreateGroups.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/CreateGroups.py): Groups the first two Walls with CreateGroups, then ungroups them again. Needs at least two Walls that are not grouped yet.

### UngroupElements

Ungroups the given groups one level, like Edit > Grouping > Ungroup: each group is dissolved, the elements and subgroups it directly contains stay. A group nested in another group is reported as failed; ungroup the containing group first. Returns an execution result per group.

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#UngroupElements

Parameters:

- `groups` (array of GroupIdArrayItem, required): The groups to ungroup, as returned by CreateGroups or GetGroupsOfElements. A group nested in another group is reported as failed: ungroup the containing group first.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `UngroupElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/UngroupElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/UngroupElements.py): Groups the first two Walls and ungroups them again with UngroupElements. Needs at least two Walls that are not grouped yet.

### GetGroupsOfElements

Gets the identifier of the group that directly contains each given element. Returns an error for elements that are not part of any group.

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetGroupsOfElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `groupGuids` (array of GroupIdOrError, required): The identifier of the group that directly contains each given element, or an error for elements that are not part of any group.

Grasshopper: `GetGroupsOfElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetGroupsOfElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetGroupsOfElements.py): Gets the group that directly contains each of the first three Walls with GetGroupsOfElements. A wall that is not in a group gets an error item. Needs at least one Wall.

### GetMainGroups

Parameters:

- `groups` (array of GroupIdArrayItem, required): The groups to get the top level group of.

Returns:

- `mainGroups` (array of GroupIdOrError, required): The top level group of each given group (the group itself if it is not nested in another group), or an error.

Grasshopper: `GetMainGroupsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetMainGroups.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetMainGroups.py): Gets the top level group of each group of the Walls with GetMainGroups. Needs at least one grouped Wall.

### GetElementSetData

Gets the elements and the custom data of each given element set. Element sets are created by add-ons to link elements together; the custom data is returned as Base64 encoded bytes.

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetElementSetData

Parameters:

- `elementSets` (array of object, required): The element sets to get the data of.
  - `elementSetId` (object, required): The identifier of an element set.

Returns:

- `elementSets` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): The data of each given element set, or an error.

Grasshopper: `GetElementSetDataComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetElementSetData.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetElementSetData.py): Creates an element set of the first two Walls, reads its elements and custom data with GetElementSetData, then deletes it. Deleting the set keeps the walls. Needs at least two Walls.

### GetUserDataOfGroups

Gets the user data an add-on attached to each given group: its version, platform sign, flags and bytes (base64 encoded), and, when its version is 1 (the layout SetUserDataOfGroups writes), its key-value pairs. Returns an error for groups that have no user data.

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetUserDataOfGroups

Parameters:

- `groups` (array of GroupIdArrayItem, required): The groups to get the user data of.

Returns:

- `userDataOfGroups` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): The user data attached to each given group, or an error for groups that have none.

Grasshopper: `GetUserDataOfGroupsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetUserDataOfGroups.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetUserDataOfGroups.py): Reads the user data add-ons attached to the groups of the Walls with GetUserDataOfGroups. A group without user data gets an error item. Needs at least one grouped Wall.

### SetUserDataOfGroups

Stores string values under keys in the user data of groups, for scripts to keep their own state on a group. The given pairs are merged into what each group already holds: a key that exists gets the new value, other keys are left as they are, and the keys listed in keysToDelete are removed. Prefix the keys with the script's name so that scripts do not overwrite each other's data. User data in another layout is left unchanged and reported as an error. One undo step per call.

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetUserDataOfGroups

Parameters:

- `groups` (array of GroupIdArrayItem, required): The groups to store the pairs on.
- `pairs` (UserDataPairs): The key-value pairs to store on each group. A key the group already holds gets the new value; other keys are left as they are.
- `keysToDelete` (UserDataKeysToDelete)

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required): One result per group, in the input order.

Grasshopper: `SetUserDataOfGroupsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/SetUserDataOfGroups.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/SetUserDataOfGroups.py): Groups the first two Walls, stores a key-value pair on the group with SetUserDataOfGroups and reads it back. The script ungroups the walls again at the end. Needs at least two Walls that are not grouped yet.

### CreateElementSets

Creates element sets of the given elements. An element set is a hidden, persistent collection of elements (it is not a group and has no effect on selection or editing).

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateElementSets

Parameters:

- `elementSets` (array of object, required): The element sets to create.
  - `elements` (Elements, required): The elements to put into the element set.

Returns:

- `elementSets` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): The identifier of each created element set, or an error, in the order of the input.

Grasshopper: `CreateElementSetsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/CreateElementSets.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/CreateElementSets.py): Creates an element set of the first two Walls with CreateElementSets, then deletes it. An element set is a hidden collection of elements; deleting it keeps the walls. Needs at least two Walls.

### DeleteElementSets

Deletes the given element sets. The elements of a set are not deleted. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On can be deleted; sets created by other add-ons are reported as failed. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and each element set that a real run would delete gets wouldDelete.

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#DeleteElementSets

Parameters:

- `elementSets` (array of object, required): The element sets to delete, as returned by CreateElementSets or GetElementSetsOfElements. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On can be deleted. The elements of a deleted set are not deleted.
  - `elementSetId` (object, required): The identifier of an element set.
- `dryRun` (DryRun)

Returns:

- `dryRun` (DryRunFlag)
- `executionResults` (DeletionExecutionResults, required): One result for each input element set, in the order of the input. On a dry run an element set that exists and was created by the Tapir Add-On gets wouldDelete.

Grasshopper: `DeleteElementSetsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/DeleteElementSets.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/DeleteElementSets.py): Creates an element set of the first two Walls and deletes it again with DeleteElementSets. The walls are kept. Only element sets created by Tapir can be deleted. Needs at least two Walls.

### GetElementSetsOfElements

Gets the element sets that contain each given element. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined; sets created by other add-ons are not found.

Group: Element grouping Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetElementSetsOfElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `elementSetsOfElements` (array of ElementSetsOfElement or ErrorItem, required): The element sets that contain each given element, or an error, in the order of the input. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined.

Grasshopper: `GetElementSetsOfElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetElementSetsOfElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/ElementGrouping/GetElementSetsOfElements.py): Gets the element sets that contain each of the first three Walls with GetElementSetsOfElements. Only element sets created by Tapir are found. Needs at least one Wall.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### Elements

array of ElementIdArrayItem: A list of elements.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### ErrorItem

object
- `error` (Error, required)

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### ExecutionResults

array of ExecutionResult: A list of execution results.

### DryRun

boolean: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

### DryRunFlag

boolean (true): Present, and true, only in the response of a dry run (the dryRun input was true): nothing was changed in the project.

### WouldDeleteExecutionResult

object: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would delete it.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)
- `wouldDelete` (boolean (true), required)

### DeletionExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or WouldDeleteExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of a deletion for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldDelete instead of being deleted.

### DeletionExecutionResults

array of DeletionExecutionResult: A list of deletion results.

### GroupId

object: The identifier of a group.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### GroupIdArrayItem

object: A wrapper containing the group identifier.
- `groupId` (GroupId, required)

### UserDataPair

object: A string value stored under a key in user data.
- `key` (string, required): The key of the value. Scripts should prefix their keys (for example 'myscript.databaseId') so that different scripts do not overwrite each other's data.
- `value` (string, required): The stored value: any text, for example an id, a timestamp or a JSON document the script encodes itself.

### UserDataPairs

array of UserDataPair: Key-value pairs stored in user data.

### UserDataKeysToDelete

array of string: The keys to remove from the user data. A key that is not stored is ignored. Applied after pairs.

### ElementsWrapper

object: A list of elements wrapped in an object.
- `elements` (Elements, required)

### ElementsWrapperOrError

ElementsWrapper or ErrorItem: A list of elements or an error.

### GroupIdOrError

GroupIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A groupId or an error.

### ElementOrGroupId

ElementIdArrayItem or GroupIdArrayItem: An identifier representing either an Element or a Group.

### ElementOrGroupIds

array of ElementOrGroupId: A list of element and/or group identifiers.

### ElementGroupParameters

object: The parameters for creating a single group
- `elements` (ElementOrGroupIds, required): The elements or child groups to be grouped.
- `parentGroupId` (GroupId): Optional parent group ID to nest this group under.

### ElementSetsOfElement

object
- `elementSets` (array of object, required): The element sets that contain the element. Empty if the element is not part of any element set.
  - `elementSetId` (object, required): The identifier of an element set.
